finding: src/anomaly/_attempt_workspace.py:40 Promotion deletes the attempt workspace before clearing the interrupted-promotion marker, so a reachable final-cleanup interruption produces a repair-required result that points to a workspace that no longer exists.
rationale: The real run_workflow → run_attempts → promote_workspace path deletes the workspace on line 40 and only then unlinks the durable marker on line 41, while startup treats any surviving marker as repair-required and unconditionally names that deleted workspace; no guard, fail-safe, or test makes the interruption window unreachable, and this violates the task's retained-workspace requirement.

workflow.py:172-174 calls recover_interrupted_promotion(case_root) at startup and immediately returns its blocked result. workflow.py:203-213 calls run_attempts from the public workflow loop. attempts.py:117 calls promote_workspace after a successful attempt, establishing a real entry path to the cleanup ordering.

233-247: _prepare_interrupted_promotion explicitly creates workspace and partial.txt before the marker is written. 637-664: the startup test writes the marker only after that preparation and asserts partial.txt remains. Thus it covers a pre-cleanup interruption, not the reachable state after discard_workspace has completed but before marker_path.unlink.

Acceptance requires: "If startup detects evidence of an interrupted promotion, it preserves every live file, records repair required, and stops" and "The blocked result identifies the phase/attempt and the retained attempt workspace so the journalist can inspect it."
